title: 第3章 另一条修炼道路第4章 出发前往凯瑟琳的家族
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
;;
在这个见鬼的游戏设定里，想要变强通常只有两条路。
一条是优雅高贵的老爷们首选。
魔法，站在后排念几个晦涩的咒语，火球冰锥满天飞，既体面又能收割少女的尖叫。
但这玩意儿讲究天赋，也就是所谓的魔法感知力。
很不幸，肖恩这具身体的魔法亲和度简直惨绝人寰，基本等同于绝缘体。
另一条路，是战士。
在这个世界，战士是粗鄙，汗水和伤痛的代名词。
修炼斗气需要打熬筋骨，那是平民和奴隶为了翻身才会去吃的苦。
贵族？别开玩笑了。
让那些细皮嫩肉的少爷去打熬筋骨？
他们宁愿去研究怎么把领结打得更花哨。
或者多找几个实力强劲的护卫。
霍尔登家族的训练场上，闷响声不断。
“少爷，真不能再练了。”
家族重金聘请的教头巴鲁，此刻正一脸活见鬼的表情，看着那个在泥地里翻滚的身影。
肖恩光着膀子，原本白皙松垮的皮肉，经过两个月的地狱折磨，已经初具线条。
汗水顺着他白色的发梢往下淌，划过胸口那几道还没完全愈合的淤青。
“闭嘴，巴鲁。”肖恩咬着牙，死死盯着面前的铁木桩，“再来。”
他没有退路。

一想到凯瑟琳那双总是带着惊恐的小鹿眼，还有那个死肥猪侯爵，肖恩觉得自己还能再做五百个俯卧撑。
为了守护最好的凯瑟琳oo，别说练斗气，就算让他练葵花宝典，他都不会……
不，这个会犹豫……
就算让他练玉女心经他都不会犹豫。
靠着霍尔登家底蕴深厚的财力，各种名贵药材跟不要钱似的往浴桶里倒。
龙血草、虎骨粉、深海蓝鲸的精油……肖恩每天晚上都感觉自己像是在被炖煮的红烧肉。
氪金改命，诚不欺我。
在这种近乎自残的苦修和金钱攻势下，那个曾经走两步都要喘的废物肖恩不见了。
取而代之的，是一个仅仅两个月就突破屏障，踏入三阶炼气士门槛的怪胎。
……
领地边缘，幽暗密林。
空气中弥漫着一股浓重的血腥味。
一头肩高两米的黑鬃魔狼轰然倒地，喉管处插着一把崩了口的精钢长剑。
肖恩坐在一旁的树根上，大口喘着粗气，手还在微微颤抖。
“三阶魔兽，也不过如此。”他抹了一把脸上的血污，露出一口白牙。
周围的侍卫们一个个面面相觑，眼里的神色从最初的不屑变成了现在的惊悚。
就在两个月前，这位少爷还只会欺压一下领地内的贵族小姐。
今天，他居然单枪匹马，硬生生磨死了一头以凶残著称的黑鬃魔狼。
这还是那个只会调戏女仆，挥霍家产的败家子吗？
“看什么看？过来扛战利品！”肖恩踢了一脚死透的魔狼，“狼皮剥整齐点，凯瑟琳……oo最近膝盖怕冷，给她做个护膝。”

侍卫们打了个激灵，连忙上前干活。
回到城堡时，正值黄昏。
肖恩浑身是泥和血痂，像个刚从死人堆里爬出来的恶鬼。

In this damn game setting, there are usually only two ways to become stronger.
One is the first choice for elegant and noble men.
Magic, standing in the back row and reciting a few obscure spells, fireballs and ice picks flying all over the sky, which is both decent and able to harvest the girl's scream.
But this thing requires talent, which is the so-called magic perception.
Unfortunately, the magic affinity of Sean's body is extremely poor, basically equivalent to an insulator.
The other way is to be a warrior.
In this world, warriors are synonymous with roughness, sweat and pain.
Practicing Dou Qi requires hard work of the muscles and bones, which is the kind of suffering that civilians and slaves only endure in order to stand up.
noble? No kidding.
Let those young masters with tender skin and tender flesh work their muscles and bones?
They would rather figure out how to make their bow tie more fancy.
Or find a few more powerful guards.
There were constant muffled sounds on the Holden family's training ground.
"Master, I really can't practice anymore."
Balu, the instructor hired by the family with a lot of money, was looking at the figure rolling in the mud with a look of horror on his face.
Sean was shirtless, and his originally fair and loose skin had begun to take shape after two months of hellish torture.
Sweat flowed down the tips of his white hair, streaking across the bruises on his chest that had not yet fully healed.
"Shut up, Balu." Sean gritted his teeth and stared at the iron stake in front of him, "Do it again."
He had no way out.
Thinking of Catherine's frightened deer eyes and that dead fat pig Marquis, Sean felt that he could do another five hundred push-ups.
In order to protect the best Catherine oo, let alone practicing fighting spirit, even if he is asked to practice the Sunflower Book, he will not...
No, this one will hesitate...
Even if he is asked to practice the Jade Girl Heart Sutra, he will not hesitate.
Relying on the Holden family's deep financial resources, all kinds of precious medicinal materials were poured into the bathtub as if they were free of charge.
Dragon blood grass, tiger bone powder, deep sea blue whale essential oil... Sean felt like he was being stewed in braised pork every night.
Krypton money can change your life, don’t deceive me sincerely.
Under this kind of self-inflicted hard work and money offensive, the good-for-nothing Sean who used to be out of breath when he took two steps disappeared.
Instead, there was a freak who broke through the barrier and stepped into the threshold of the third level Qi Refiner in just two months.
…
At the edge of the territory, there is a dark forest.
There was a strong smell of blood in the air.
A two-meter-high black-maned demonic wolf fell to the ground with a crash, with a broken stainless steel sword stuck in its throat.
Sean sat on a tree root nearby, breathing heavily, his hands still shaking slightly.
"A third-level monster is nothing more than that." He wiped the blood on his face, revealing his white teeth.
The surrounding guards all looked at each other, the expressions in their eyes changing from disdain to horror now.
Just two months ago, this young master would only bully the noble ladies in his territory.
Today, he actually single-handedly killed a black-maned demonic wolf that was famous for its ferocity.
Is this still the prodigal son who only flirts with the maid and squanders the family fortune?
"What are you looking at? Come here and carry the loot!" Sean kicked the dead demon wolf. "Skin the wolf skin neatly, Catherine...oo, my knees are afraid of the cold recently, so make her a kneepad."
The guards trembled and hurriedly stepped forward to work.
It was dusk when we returned to the castle.
Sean was covered in mud and blood scabs, like an evil ghost who had just climbed out of a pile of dead people.
